resources.string: Blur, tint, scrim and rendering for classic Explore source rows
Picking a style applies a whole preset; the sliders below fine-tune on top of it
Following the bottom bar material (%1$s); turn off Follow bottom bar to choose a style here
Use the bottom bar Solid / Glass / Frosted glass style directly; the style chosen here is ignored. Solid maps to No glass
Same setting as Explore glass in theme editing, stored separately for day and night; 0 turns the effect off
100 is the default, 0 is weakest, 200 doubles it; applies to both hardware Gaussian and software blur
Opacity of the gradient backing behind source names; higher values separate text from the wallpaper more strongly
Strength of the faint white tint on the glass surface
Visibility of the rounded edge stroke; higher values make the outline clearer
Available on Android 12 and above; disabling forces the verified software blur fallback
When enabled, animated wallpapers are not sampled as a still first frame; disable it to accept a static glass frame
Clears every setting on this page, including the material style and day / night glass strength

string-array.name: explore_glass_mode_descriptions
string-array.item: Source rows use the plain transparent background; always the case on e-ink and low-memory devices
Light blur and thin scrim let the wallpaper show through, with the edge stroke outlining the glass; text contrast is slightly lower
Default look, with the strongest blur and scrim for maximum text legibility
